# A workflow snippet, kept as .txt so this repository does not run it on itself.
# Copy to .github/workflows/triage.yml in the repository you want triaged.
name: triage

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docket:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Whatever produces your findings. Any SARIF will do.
      - uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          generateSarif: "1"

      - uses: ethanpturner/docket@main
        id: triage
        with:
          finding: semgrep.sarif
          # Decisions carried between runs. Commit this file; a decision expires on its own
          # when the code it was made against changes.
          baseline: .docket/baseline.json
          # Start here. Turn one on once the team agrees the queue should stay at zero.
          fail-on-new: "false"
          fail-on-stale: "false"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: docket
          path: |
            .docket/out/openvex.json
            .docket/out/summary.md
